text:
gamescom Opening Night Live 2026 Livestream
Tune in for gamescom ONL 2026 with host Geoff Keighley and Sjokz live from Cologne, Germany with a look at what's next in video games on Tuesday, August 25 at 11am PT/ 2pm ET/ 8pm CEST.

The showcase will run for about 2 hours, with a pre-show hosted by Kyle Bosman. 

Tune in after ONL ends as GameSpot talks about the biggest reveals, news, announcements, and updates in our Post-Show.

text:
The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt Remastered - Official Announcement Trailer
Coming on September 29, this is the definitive way to experience Geralt of Rivia’s legendary adventure. The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt — Remastered features an array of improvements, bringing upgrades to visuals, gameplay, and more.

Remastered is a free upgrade for players who own The Witcher 3 on GOG, Steam, Epic Games Store, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X|S, and includes both Hearts of Stone and Blood and Wine expansions. It is also available for pre-purchase on Battle.net and Nintendo Switch 2.

author: GameSpot YouTube
text:
Gears Of War: E-Day Seems To Miss The Point Of Prequels - Preview
Having now played about two hours of Gears of War: E-Day, I'm not impressed. 

The upcoming third-person cover shooter handles fine and the demo I played through checked all the hits you'd expect from the genre--intense action, cringy one-liners, lots of blood, a desperate gamble to cross a bridge while being peppered by sniper fire. But of what I've seen, it seems like E-Day misses the mark that all prequels should try to hit.

text:
Turok: Origins - Official Story Trailer
Every legend has a beginning. Watch the new story trailer for Turok: Origins featured in #gamescom Opening Night Live.

Clawing its way onto PlayStation 5, XBOX Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC Spring 2027.

Be among the first to experience Turok: Origins at gamescom 2026. Visit us at the XBOX booth in Hall 7 at booth A-0.61 and get hands-on with a brand-new demo ahead of its Spring 2027 launch.

Hunt Alone or Together:
Take on the adventure solo or team up with friends in online co-op as you battle to save humanity from extinction.

Battle Dinosaurs, Aliens, and Bosses:
Face ferocious dinosaurs, deadly alien forces, and massive boss encounters that will test your skill, strategy, and teamwork.

Wield a Powerful Arsenal:
Unlock and upgrade an arsenal of futuristic weapons, from plasma rifles and sniper weapons to bows, shotguns, and experimental alien technology.

Harness Turok Powers:
Collect Echoes and unlock powerful abilities to customize your combat style, enhance your strengths, and gain the upper hand in battle.

Explore the Lost Lands:
Journey across breathtaking worlds filled with ancient ruins, dense jungles, alien landscapes, and hidden secrets as you uncover the mysteries of the Lost Lands.

Warlock: Dungeons & Dragons - Official Gameplay Reveal Trailer
Make the pact. Wield the forbidden.

Watch the gameplay reveal for Warlock: Dungeons & Dragons, a third-person, single-player action-adventure set in a dark fantasy open world inspired by D&D.

Play as Kaatri, an experienced warrior who makes a dangerous pact with Tasha to find someone she has lost. Combine forbidden magic, spells, rituals, and otherworldly weapons to open paths, create advantages, uncover secrets, and defeat monsters creatively. Venture beyond the Mists of Darkon, where danger, opportunity, and hidden power wait around every corner.

Currently in development for PC, PlayStation 5, and Xbox.

Revealed at Gamescom Opening Night Live, our second gameplay trailer - Renegade, gives you a further glimpse into the protagonist, The Stranger.  

We are showing you more of our mechanics, weaponry and combat both below and above ground. 

We know how important the series is to our community, and we’re committed to crafting the ultimate METRO experience - one that draws on the very best of the series’ history, while dramatically expanding its scope for atmosphere, immersion and powerful storytelling.

If you’re fortunate enough to be at Gamescom yourself this year, we’d love to see you at our booth in Hall 9.1! Stop by while you’re here at the show and you’ll have the chance to lose yourself in the first demo of a METRO experience you’ll never forget.
